subject: English Language
name: Basic 6 English Language
description: Part 2 of the Basic 6 English Language curriculum covers Grammar Usage, Writing, Writing Conventions, and Extensive Reading. It focuses on advanced grammatical structures, complex sentence formation, diverse writing modes, and developing a strong reading culture.

strands.title: Grammar Usage at Word and Phrase Levels
strands.description: Developing advanced understanding and usage of grammatical structures.

subStrands.title: Nouns
subStrands.description: Using nouns to describe conditions and activities.

contentStandards.description: Apply knowledge of different types of nouns in communication

indicators.description: Identify and use nouns or noun phrases to describe conditions

exemplars.description: Use nouns/noun phrases in sentences to describe conditions.

indicators.description: Identify and use proper, count/non-count, singular/plural nouns

exemplars.description: Practice using different noun types in sentences.

indicators.description: Use '-ing' nouns and noun phrases to refer to activities

exemplars.description: Use gerunds in sentences (e.g., I enjoy singing).

indicators.description: Identify and use abstract nouns to refer to concepts and ideas

exemplars.description: Identify and use abstract nouns like intelligence, knowledge, patience.

contentStandards.description: Apply knowledge of different types of determiners in communication

indicators.description: Identify and use definite and indefinite articles

exemplars.description: Identify and use 'a', 'an', 'the' correctly in text.

indicators.description: Identify and use quantifiers

exemplars.description: Use quantifiers like some, few, no, both, all, each.

indicators.description: Identify and use possessive pronouns to show possession

exemplars.description: Identify words indicating possession in texts.

indicators.description: Identify and use demonstratives: this/that, these/those

exemplars.description: Write sentences using demonstratives.

indicators.description: Identify and use interrogative determiners

exemplars.description: Use interrogative determiners (which, whose) to ask questions.

subStrands.title: Pronouns
subStrands.description: Using reflexive, relative, and reciprocal pronouns.

contentStandards.description: Apply knowledge of different types of pronouns in communication

indicators.description: Identify and use reflexive, relative and reciprocal pronouns

exemplars.description: Use reflexive pronouns (myself, yourself), relative pronouns (which, where), and reciprocal pronouns (each other).

contentStandards.description: Apply the knowledge of adjectives in communication

indicators.description: Use comparatives forms of regular and irregular adjectives to make comparisons

exemplars.description: Form comparative and superlative adjectives.

subStrands.title: Verbs
subStrands.description: Using various verb forms and tenses.

contentStandards.description: Apply the knowledge of verbs in communication

indicators.description: Use different types of verbs (Main and Helping)

exemplars.description: Identify and distinguish main verbs from auxiliary verbs.

indicators.description: Use appropriate subject-verb agreement

exemplars.description: Use indefinite pronouns, singular/plural, and collective nouns with appropriate verbs.

indicators.description: Use different forms of verbs: Irregular and Infinitive

exemplars.description: Use infinitives to talk about personal activities.

indicators.description: Use the simple present form of verbs for future actions

exemplars.description: Use simple present for scheduled future actions and future possibilities.

indicators.description: Use the past continuous form of verbs

exemplars.description: Talk about actions going on when a second action took place.

indicators.description: Use the imperative form of verb to give warning and express prohibitions

exemplars.description: Use imperatives for warnings (e.g., Break the glass, and you will pay for it).

subStrands.title: Adverbs
subStrands.description: Using adverbs of degree and reason.

contentStandards.description: Apply the knowledge of different types of adverbs in communication

indicators.description: Use adverbs to express degree and reason

exemplars.description: Use adverbs of degree (too, so much) and reason (because).

contentStandards.description: Understand and use idiomatic expressions appropriately in speech and in writing

indicators.description: Identify, explain and use idiomatic expressions correctly

exemplars.description: Interpret and use idiomatic expressions in sentences.

subStrands.title: Conjunctions
subStrands.description: Using conjunctions for purpose, time, and condition.

contentStandards.description: Apply the knowledge of conjunctions in speech and in writing

indicators.description: Identify and use simple conjunctions - so that, when, while, if

exemplars.description: Use conjunctions to show purpose, express time, and express condition.

subStrands.title: Modals
subStrands.description: Using modals to express variety of meanings.

contentStandards.description: Apply the knowledge of modals in speech and in writing

indicators.description: Use modals to express a variety of meanings

exemplars.description: Use modals for ability, permission, obligation, prediction, possibility.

contentStandards.description: Apply the knowledge of prepositions in oral and written communication

indicators.description: Use prepositions to convey a variety of meanings

exemplars.description: Use prepositions for time, purpose, possession, comparison, support/opposition.

contentStandards.description: Show understanding of adjective phrases in oral and written communication

indicators.description: Form and use adjective phrases correctly

exemplars.description: Identify and form adjective phrases in sentences.

contentStandards.description: Show understanding of adverb phrases in oral and written communication

indicators.description: Form and use adverb phrases correctly

exemplars.description: Identify and use adverb phrases in sentences.

contentStandards.description: Show understanding of direct and reported speeches in oral and written communication

indicators.description: Form and use reported speech appropriately

exemplars.description: Change direct speech into reported speech.

strands.title: Writing
strands.description: Developing writing skills through penmanship, paragraph development, and various writing forms.

subStrands.title: Penmanship and Handwriting
subStrands.description: Writing legibly and using complex sentences.

contentStandards.description: Copy and rewrite sentences correctly

indicators.description: Write with a legible, fluent and personal handwriting style

exemplars.description: Copy sentences in joint script.

indicators.description: Write complex sentences clearly and correctly

exemplars.description: Combine simple sentences into complex sentences.

subStrands.title: Paragraph Development
subStrands.description: Structuring paragraphs with main and supporting ideas.

contentStandards.description: Develop, organise and express ideas cohesively in writing

indicators.description: Choose appropriate ways and modes of writing

exemplars.description: Select appropriate writing modes (e.g., narrative, persuasive) for specific purposes.

indicators.description: Use key words, phrases or clauses to introduce the main idea

exemplars.description: Identify and write topic sentences and supporting ideas.

indicators.description: Elaborate on, explain and/or justify the main ideas of a paragraph

exemplars.description: Provide details and examples to elaborate on main ideas.

indicators.description: Use cohesive devices to link ideas in a paragraph

exemplars.description: Use connectors and cohesive devices to link ideas.

subStrands.title: Writing as a Process
subStrands.description: Applying the writing process for various topics.

contentStandards.description: Apply the skills and strategies for idea generation

indicators.description: Select a topic of choice on a national issue, brainstorm and organize ideas

exemplars.description: Generate and organize ideas using graphic organizers.

contentStandards.description: Develop and express ideas coherently and cohesively in writing

indicators.description: Develop ideas into a three-paragraph draft

exemplars.description: Draft paragraphs using cohesive devices.

contentStandards.description: Apply strategies for improving drafts for publishing

indicators.description: Review, and revise the draft to produce a coherent piece

exemplars.description: Review drafts for clarity and organization.

indicators.description: Edit/proofread draft, checking capitalisation, usage of punctuation and spelling

exemplars.description: Check drafts for errors and peer edit.

indicators.description: Publish writing piece for other peers to read

exemplars.description: Publish work in class magazines or notice boards.

contentStandards.description: Narrate situations, express feelings and convey point of view

indicators.description: Create settings, characters and at least one plot in a narrative text

exemplars.description: Write reflective narratives focusing on personal change.

subStrands.title: Creative/Free Writing
subStrands.description: Writing creatively on national issues and creating poems/stories.

contentStandards.description: Create texts

indicators.description: Write freely about topics of choice on national issues

exemplars.description: Brainstorm, draft, and publish creative pieces on national issues.

indicators.description: Write poems and imaginative narrative stories

exemplars.description: Write stories and poems applying narrative elements.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate knowledge of descriptive words/expressions in writing

indicators.description: Use descriptive words/sound devices/ figurative language

exemplars.description: Describe places and events using sensory details and figurative language.

subStrands.title: Argumentative/Persuasive Writing
subStrands.description: Writing arguments with reasons and evidence.

contentStandards.description: Support an opinion in writing

indicators.description: Write explanations and examples to support opinions

exemplars.description: Take a stand on a motion and support it.

contentStandards.description: Write arguments to support claims with clear reasons and relevant evidence

indicators.description: Introduce claims and support with clear reasons in order of importance

exemplars.description: Provide reasons and evidence for opinions.

indicators.description: Use words, phrases, and clauses to clarify the relationships

exemplars.description: Use appropriate language for arguments.

indicators.description: Establish and maintain a formal style

exemplars.description: Structure argumentative pieces with introduction, reasons, and conclusion.

indicators.description: Provide a concluding statement

exemplars.description: Write concluding statements and debate topics.

contentStandards.description: Write informative/ expository essays

indicators.description: Write short paragraphs to describe incidents

exemplars.description: Write paragraphs describing incidents like accidents or fire outbreaks.

contentStandards.description: Write the event of the day

indicators.description: Write articles on varied topics

exemplars.description: Write informative articles.

contentStandards.description: Write informal letters on given topics

indicators.description: Write to friends to express their views on given topics

exemplars.description: Identify features of informal letters and write one.

strands.title: Using Writing Conventions/ Grammar Usage
strands.description: Applying grammar conventions including capitalisation, punctuation, nouns, verbs, adjectives, adverbs, prepositions, conjunctions, and complex sentences.

contentStandards.description: Use capital letters to start the first word in direct speech

indicators.description: Follow appropriate mechanical convention

exemplars.description: Write letters paying attention to capitalization and other punctuation.

subStrands.title: Using Punctuation
subStrands.description: Using commas, quotation marks, and apostrophes.

contentStandards.description: Show understanding of how punctuations are used appropriately in writing

indicators.description: Use comma, quotation marks, and apostrophe

exemplars.description: Use commas for modifying phrases, quotation marks for direct speech, and apostrophes for plural possession.

subStrands.title: Using Naming Words/Nouns
subStrands.description: Using nouns, '-ing' nouns, and abstract nouns.

contentStandards.description: Apply knowledge of different types of nouns in communication

indicators.description: Identify and use nouns or noun phrases to describe conditions

exemplars.description: Use nouns to describe conditions.

indicators.description: Identify and use proper nouns, count/non-count, singular/plural

exemplars.description: Practice using various noun types in sentences.

indicators.description: Use the '-ing' nouns to refer to activities

exemplars.description: Use gerunds (e.g., singing, swimming).

indicators.description: Identify and use abstract nouns to refer to concepts and ideas

exemplars.description: Use abstract nouns in sentences.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of verbs in everyday language

indicators.description: Differentiate between how the simple past and the present perfect tense forms are used

exemplars.description: Write stories using simple past and present perfect tenses.

indicators.description: Explore the use of the simple past verb form and participle form

exemplars.description: Write essays using past and participle forms.

indicators.description: Use a range of verb forms in speech and in writing

exemplars.description: Use simple past and past perfect tenses in narration.

indicators.description: Apply the use of the singular and plural subject and the verb forms that go with them

exemplars.description: Write essays applying correct subject-verb agreement.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of adjectives in speech and in writing

indicators.description: Use superlative forms of regular and irregular adjectives to make comparison

exemplars.description: Use comparative and superlative adjectives in descriptions.

subStrands.title: Using Qualifying Words- Adverbs
subStrands.description: Using adverbs of degree and reason.

contentStandards.description: Understand and use adverbs correctly in speech and in writing

indicators.description: Use adverbs to express degree and reason

exemplars.description: Use adverbs of degree and reason in paragraphs.

contentStandards.description: Apply the knowledge of prepositions in oral and written communication

indicators.description: Use prepositions to convey a variety of meanings

exemplars.description: Use prepositions for time, purpose, possession, comparison, support/opposition.

subStrands.title: Using Conjunctions
subStrands.description: Using conjunctions for purpose, time, and condition.

contentStandards.description: Apply the knowledge of conjunctions in speech and in writing

indicators.description: Identify and use conjunctions - so that, when, while, if etc.

exemplars.description: Use conjunctions to show purpose, express time, and express condition.

subStrands.title: Using Simple, Compound and Compound Sentences

contentStandards.description: Apply knowledge of grammatical rules to form words, phrases and sentences

indicators.description: Identify subjects and verb in complex sentences

exemplars.description: Identify subjects and predicates in complex sentences.

indicators.description: Construct complex sentences correctly

exemplars.description: Change compound sentences into complex ones.

contentStandards.description: Spell words accurately

indicators.description: Check pieces of literary work for spelling

exemplars.description: Correct spellings in extracts.

subStrands.title: Building the Love and Culture of Reading

contentStandards.description: Read widely for pleasure, and to demonstrate independent reading and learning in the literary/content areas

indicators.description: Read and critique a variety of age- and level appropriate books

exemplars.description: Read books independently and present critical commentaries.
